items.headline: Albemarle Stock Slides 28% in 3 Months: Should You Buy the Dip?
items.snippet: ALB expects lithium demand to witness a CAGR of 10-20% from 2025 to 2030, with stationary storage a significant driver alongside EVs. Demand expected to grow roughly 15-40% this year, trending near the higher end of the range.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $225 from $245 at Truist
items.snippet: Truist analyst Peter Osterland lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $225 from $245 and keeps a Buy rating, citing resilient lithium demand and constrained supply dynamics.
